title: Restoring a Theater and Its Reputation

paragraphs.en: The meeting in the old theater was tense. A financial scandal had interrupted its restoration, and the town feared losing a magnificent building. The former director had appeared drunk at a fundraiser, while a dubious contractor disappeared with public money. Residents expressed grief and horror at the betrayal. Yet a loyal group of volunteers refused to abandon the project. Their leader, Ada, was humble about her experience and insisted that the next stage protect both the theater and the dignity of everyone who worked there. She knew that restoring a building would be easier than restoring the confidence of its neighbors.
paragraphs.zh: 老剧院里的会议气氛紧张。财务丑闻打断修缮，居民担心失去这座宏伟建筑。前任主管醉酒出席募款活动，可疑承包商又携公款消失，人们悲伤而震惊。忠诚的志愿者仍不肯放弃。负责人艾达谦虚承认经验有限，要求新阶段既保护剧院，也保护参与者的尊严。她知道修复邻里的信任，比修复建筑更难。

paragraphs.en: Ada began with a lively open evening. Volunteers greeted every visitor with a simple hi and offered tea at the entrance. A considerate host remembered that one elderly neighbor needed a gentle voice rather than loud music. A dear friend of the former director arrived uneasy, expecting cruel jokes and nasty gossip. Instead, she received courtesy, grace, and a tender invitation to join the discussion. Ada did not want to embarrass anyone by demanding public loyalty. Her intuition was that harmony would grow from respectful contact, not from a bold speech asking people to forget what had happened.
paragraphs.zh: 艾达先办了一场热闹的开放活动。志愿者用简单问候迎接来宾，并递上茶。体贴的接待者记得一位老人需要温和说话，而非响亮音乐。前主管的一位好友不安地来访，担心残酷玩笑和恶意闲话，得到的却是礼貌、优雅与亲切邀请。艾达不愿逼人公开表态，令其尴尬。她直觉认为，和谐来自尊重接触，不是靠大胆演说要求大家忘记过去。

paragraphs.en: Some residents dismissed the restoration as a weird fantasy. Others became impatient when they learned that the new plan was less extravagant than the original one. A handsome model of a splendid extension had once filled the lobby, promising glory to its architect. Now the volunteers would repair the roof before adding any decorative feature. To aspire to a successful theater, Ada argued, did not require pretending that every ambitious idea was affordable. She tried to tame unrealistic expectations without discouraging brave suggestions. A faint possibility of progress was preferable to another impressive promise made in vain.
paragraphs.zh: 一些居民认为修缮是古怪幻想，另一些人得知新方案不像原方案那么奢华，便不耐烦。大厅曾摆着漂亮的扩建模型，许诺为建筑师带来荣耀；如今志愿者先修屋顶，再考虑装饰。艾达认为，追求成功剧院不等于假装每个雄心都负担得起。她努力约束不现实的期待，又不打击勇敢建议。微弱的进步可能，胜过又一次徒劳的华丽承诺。

paragraphs.en: The difficult months tested every conscience. An arrogant donor threatened to withdraw support unless his name dominated the entrance, and a reckless volunteer promised repairs he could not safely perform. Ada was sometimes mad at these demands, but she refused to turn disagreement into personal revenge. When an awful storm flooded the workshop, despair briefly replaced enthusiasm. Nevertheless, diligent neighbors returned the following morning to dry tools and sort timber. Their practical kindness generated more gratitude than any grand announcement. Even those who had felt envy toward the restoration team began to recognize the unpaid labor behind its achievements.
paragraphs.zh: 艰难的几个月考验着每个人的良心。傲慢的捐款人要求入口突出他的名字，否则撤资；鲁莽的志愿者承诺做自己无法安全完成的维修。艾达有时生气，却不把分歧变成报复。可怕暴风雨淹了工作室，绝望一度取代热情。然而勤奋的邻居次日便来晾工具、分木料。实际善意比宏大宣布更令人感激，连嫉妒团队的人也开始看到成果背后的无偿劳动。

paragraphs.en: On opening night, the audience stood in awe beneath the repaired ceiling. Ada felt ashamed of how close she had come to giving up, but she also understood that no one should be expected to endure difficulty without help. The program avoided sentimental claims that everything was perfect. Its central sentiment was simpler: people could care for a shared place despite different histories and opinions. The theater had regained neither its former luxury nor a flawless reputation. What it possessed was more durable: a community willing to question dubious decisions, acknowledge mistakes, and return together to unfinished work.
paragraphs.zh: 重新开放当晚，观众敬畏地站在修好的天花板下。艾达为自己几乎放弃而羞愧，也明白不该要求任何人独自承受困难。节目没有煽情地宣称一切完美，表达的是更简单的情感：历史和意见不同的人，仍能共同爱护一个地方。剧院未恢复旧日奢华，也没有无瑕名声，却拥有更持久的东西：愿意质疑可疑决策、承认错误并一起完成未竟工作的人群。
